name: The Patient Shortcut
new_mark: A small red-ochre and charcoal tortoise resting on bare rock above the old sun.

preservation.ancestral_marks: Pepe, both hands, branching paths, sun, snail, stepping stones and handprint are outside the changed patch.

visual_review.method: Inspected inherited PNG, generated edit, final assembled PNG and final 512px JPEG with the image viewer.

implementation.compatibility: Workplan self-test and Replan's 14-test suite passed; original Optplan demo still finishes in 11 minutes.
implementation.limits: At most 14 tasks, integer-minute estimates and identical continuously available workers. State exhaustion returns no optimality claim. Estimated completion is not a real deadline guarantee.

requirements_conflict: The brief both requires a JPEG beside dist/line-1/24.json and forbids pictures outside artifacts. Followed the explicit numbered JPEG path, consistent with preceding rounds; it is the only new picture outside artifacts.
authority: These are local measurements and manual visual observations, not independent certification.
